rows.q: Summarize the quarantine procedure for critical.

rows.q: Summarize the inspect procedure for critical.
rows.draft: The critical inspect procedure consists of four steps: 1) Verify the delivery against the purchase order; 2) Draw the AQL sample from at least three cartons; 3) Inspect labels, seals and temperature logs; 4) Record results and accept or reject the lot.
rows.answer: Step 4 of the inspect procedure (critical): Record results and accept or reject the lot.
